caption:
The video captures a white Joby eVTOL aircraft, tail registration N542BJ, flying low over a dry brown grass airfield. Six rotor pods mounted on angled booms spin continuously, their blades rendered as translucent blurs. A dark tinted cabin canopy and fixed tricycle landing gear remain fully extended throughout. The craft holds a steady nose-right attitude as it advances, the camera tracking alongside it so that hangars, a concrete perimeter wall and a line of trees drift toward the left edge.

Distant hazy mountains rise along the horizon under a bright, partly cloudy sky. The aircraft stays roughly centered, its height above the foreground field and its slight tail-up attitude looking broadly constant. No rotor start-up or shutdown occurs, and the landing gear never retracts. The continuous leftward scroll of the background confirms the aircraft is moving forward relative to the ground rather than sitting still, the craft gliding steadily across the airfield.
